Class StoredResultsModel

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.StoredResultsModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
MeasureDefinition
public class StoredResultsModel extends Object implements MeasureDefinition

Title: Result's Model data structure

Description: This class will store all values of measured loaded from a file. it is used by XMLResultsReader.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 3-ott-2005 Time: 14.10.50 Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.
